failure.message: The workflow pre-acquired fzy, then the calibration helper attempted a second acquisition. The existing active target correctly caused acquisition to refuse before any scenario launch.
failure.target_cleanup: Cleanup was invoked with the report-required mode and failed because no scenario report existed. Storage verification passed; the active source is retained in the failed job artifact for diagnosis.

corrective_action: Remove redundant workflow-level target acquisition; let each baseline/fault/restored phase acquire, build and clean its own exact source. Select no-case cleanup when an interrupted phase has no target reports, and surface bounded helper output in the workflow log.
scope: Preserved failed workflow attempt; no target scenario ran and no fault or project admission credit is claimed.
